 KATHMANDU, Nov 2: Kathmandu Gorkhas won the toss and elected to bowl first against Karnali Yaks in the Nepal Premier League (NPL) at the TU International Cricket Ground on Monday.
 Kathmandu captain Karan KC chose to field after winning the toss.
 Related story

 Australian batter David Warner is making his NPL debut for Kathmandu Gorkhas in today’s match.
 Warner has represented Australia in 112 Test matches, 161 One-Day Internationals (ODIs) and 110 T20 Internationals, scoring nearly 19,000 runs across international formats.
 He was also part of the Australian teams that won the T20 World Cup in 2021 and the ODI World Cups in 2015 and 2023.
 Warner’s highest Test score is an unbeaten 335 against Pakistan.
